success_rubric: The target is the top drawer on the {side} side identified by the task. Judge how far that drawer's box has slid out relative to its closed position. Success requires at least 52.25% of its front-to-back depth to slide out, a little more than halfway. A small gap, a grasped handle, or a different drawer opening is not success. The target need not reach maximum extension, and the robot may keep holding its handle. Use the best state reached in any of the three synchronized views during the observed video; later closing does not undo an earlier success.
